basis: Nursery Automation specification; user-supplied estimating plan O1-O15 and DP1-DP8 adopted 2026-10-22

Equipment.purpose: One exact supplier model and options variant. Duplicate this sheet for another equipment record.

fields.label: Equipment record ID
fields.guidance: Stable staging ID; runtime UUID assigned through governed onboarding.

fields.label: PPO company key
fields.guidance: Company scope; never infer from supplier name.

fields.label: Supplier entity key
fields.guidance: Exact provider/company/entity identity when verified.

fields.label: Manufacturer
fields.guidance: Enter Javo for real Javo evidence; example is fictional.

fields.label: Model name
fields.guidance: Preserve supplier spelling.

fields.label: Variant or configuration code
fields.guidance: Region, revision and installed options matter.

fields.label: Record version
fields.guidance: Data version independent of document title.

fields.label: Equipment family
fields.guidance: First release supports reviewed Javo potting-line configurations.

fields.label: Applicable region
fields.guidance: No assumed global electrical or option compatibility.

fields.label: Supported operations
fields.guidance: Semicolon-separated staging list; no executable rules.

fields.label: Container shapes and constraints
fields.guidance: Include nesting, material and sample restrictions.

fields.label: Minimum container diameter
fields.guidance: Synthetic example only; verify inclusive/exclusive limit.

fields.label: Maximum container diameter
fields.guidance: Do not substitute nominal volume for geometry.

fields.label: Maximum container height
fields.guidance: State options and scope in evidence.

fields.label: Maximum handled mass
fields.guidance: Specify empty/filled pot and plant mass basis.

fields.label: Compatible media conditions
fields.guidance: Particle size, moisture, bridging and conditioning.

fields.label: Published capacity observation
fields.guidance: Not a sustained line guarantee; retain conditions and rate basis.

fields.label: Capacity basis
fields.guidance: Do not apply quality/downtime twice.

fields.label: Capacity conditions
fields.guidance: Exact container, media, options, staffing and test method.

fields.label: Machine footprint length
fields.guidance: Transport envelope and maintenance clearance are separate.

fields.label: Machine footprint width
fields.guidance: Record installed option envelope.

fields.label: Machine height
fields.guidance: Separate required clear height.

fields.label: Maintenance and access clearance
fields.guidance: Never infer safe clearance from machine dimensions.

fields.label: Electrical supply requirements
fields.guidance: Confirm voltage, frequency, phase, current, connector and protection.

fields.label: Compressed air requirements
fields.guidance: Record pressure and flow with basis; availability is not capacity.

fields.label: Water and drainage requirements
fields.guidance: Preserve hygiene/washdown conditions.

fields.label: Controls and stop interface
fields.guidance: Protocol version, signals and safe stop boundary require review.

fields.label: Products Variant ID
fields.guidance: Example is not a runtime UUID or mapping.

fields.label: Products revision ID
fields.guidance: Exact published revision, never latest by label.

fields.label: Products content hash
fields.guidance: Exact verified SHA-256; no invented hash.

fields.label: Exact Variant unit
fields.guidance: No guessed unit conversion at receiving.

fields.label: Delivery profile references
fields.guidance: Profiles are defaults; services need explicit selection and coverage.

fields.label: Record review state
fields.guidance: Reviewed is not manufacturer or operational approval.

fields.label: Reviewing owner
fields.guidance: Named authorised role/person and evidence.

fields.label: Review date
fields.guidance: Enter a real Excel date; display YYYY-MM-DD.

Options.purpose: One selectable accessory or tooling option linked to an equipment record. Duplicate for further options.

fields.label: Option record ID
fields.guidance: Stable option identity.

fields.label: Parent equipment ID
fields.guidance: Reference an exact Equipment record.

fields.label: Supplier option code
fields.guidance: Preserve external code; not a PPO Product ID.

fields.label: Option description
fields.guidance: State function and applicable variant.

fields.label: Option definition version
fields.guidance: Retain historical definitions.

fields.label: Applicability condition
fields.guidance: Plain-language reviewed predicate; not executable text.

fields.label: Required option IDs
fields.guidance: Check dependency closure; cycles require resolution.

fields.label: Incompatible option IDs
fields.guidance: Do not sum incompatible choices.

fields.label: Quantity basis
fields.guidance: Reviewed rule determines quantity; unknown is not one.

fields.label: Quantity per basis
fields.guidance: Synthetic quantity; preserve decimal and unit basis.

fields.label: Shared item owner
fields.guidance: One owner across equipment instances.

fields.label: Products Variant ID
fields.guidance: Separate exact Variant/revision/hash.

fields.label: Products revision ID
fields.guidance: No automatic latest revision.

fields.label: Products content hash
fields.guidance: Verified SHA-256 only.

fields.label: Exact Variant unit
fields.guidance: Must match mapped unit.

fields.label: Delivery profiles
fields.guidance: Check assembly versus component coverage.

fields.label: Review state
fields.guidance: No published option rule inferred from a catalogue description.

Interfaces.purpose: One connection requirement between exact proposed equipment instances. Duplicate for every connection.

fields.label: Connection ID
fields.guidance: Stable connection identity.

fields.label: Upstream instance ID
fields.guidance: Project instance, not supplier model name.

fields.label: Downstream instance ID
fields.guidance: Retained equipment can be the target.

fields.label: Production scenario ID
fields.guidance: Validate all required scenarios separately.

fields.label: Transfer direction
fields.guidance: State viewing reference; do not assume orientation.

fields.label: Transfer height
fields.guidance: Confirm both sides and allowable tolerance.

fields.label: Usable transfer width
fields.guidance: Include pot/tray clearance and guides.

fields.label: Container pitch
fields.guidance: Different pitch may require accumulation or metering.

fields.label: Required transfer rate
fields.guidance: Same units and gross/net basis as scenario.

fields.label: Required transfer adapter
fields.guidance: Link selected option/part where known.

fields.label: Control handshake
fields.guidance: Signal types, protocol and responsibility.

fields.label: Stop and restart boundary
fields.guidance: No safety compliance inferred by this template.

fields.label: Integration responsibility
fields.guidance: Unknown responsibility blocks resolved scope.

fields.label: Compatibility assessment
fields.guidance: Confirmed requires applicable evidence, not matching dimensions alone.

fields.label: Confirmation source
fields.guidance: Exact supplier or engineering evidence.

fields.label: Review state
fields.guidance: Separate internal review from supplier confirmation.

Delivery profiles.purpose: One reusable delivery profile. Link activities/content; do not price work or assume service inclusion.

fields.label: Profile ID
fields.guidance: Stable shared profile identity.

fields.label: Profile version
fields.guidance: Explicit adoption; publishing does not refresh saved work.

fields.label: Profile attaches to
fields.guidance: Shared project work must not repeat per machine.

fields.label: Attachment identity
fields.guidance: Exact product/assembly/system scope.

fields.label: Profile owner
fields.guidance: Nominated owner; no assumed approval.

fields.label: Applicability conditions
fields.guidance: Include regional, phase and delivery restrictions.

fields.label: Inherited profiles
fields.guidance: Exact versions with explicit precedence.

fields.label: Inheritance policy
fields.guidance: Never silently add overlapping setup or component work.

fields.label: Activity standard references
fields.guidance: Exact IDs/versions; missing required standards need reviewed Manual basis.

fields.label: Covered equipment and work
fields.guidance: Define assembly/component boundaries.

fields.label: Work not covered by profile
fields.guidance: Profile coverage is not commercial exclusion.

fields.label: Approved content references
fields.guidance: Content has its own review/publication owner.

fields.label: Effective from
fields.guidance: Real date; applicable period.

fields.label: Effective to
fields.guidance: Blank means unspecified, not automatically current forever.

fields.label: Profile technical review
fields.guidance: Publishing is a separate governed action, not an Excel edit.

fields.label: Reviewer
fields.guidance: Actual attribution and evidence required.

fields.label: PPO company key
fields.guidance: Company-scoped registry; no cross-company lookup.

fields.label: Publication state
fields.guidance: Separate from technical review; an Excel entry publishes nothing.

Activity standards.purpose: One governed effort standard. Reusable standards are separate from resolved project selection and from monetary rates.

fields.label: Activity ID
fields.guidance: Stable shared activity identity.

fields.label: Standard version
fields.guidance: Retain original standard after newer publication.

fields.label: Activity category
fields.guidance: Separate installation and commissioning totals.

fields.label: Activity description
fields.guidance: Identify measurable work.

fields.label: Technical driver key
fields.guidance: Candidate shared fact key; final contract must confirm.

fields.label: Driver unit
fields.guidance: Installed quantities, not purchased packs by default.

fields.label: Effort basis
fields.guidance: Inverse productivity and crew conversions occur once.

fields.label: Standard value
fields.guidance: Invented example only; no operational default.

fields.label: Fixed setup effort
fields.guidance: Separate ownership prevents repeated setup.

fields.label: Crew composition
fields.guidance: Required only for crew conversion; no double multiplier.

fields.label: Required role/skill
fields.guidance: Exact rate binding is resolved in CPQ.

fields.label: Conditions
fields.guidance: Review height/access/handling conditions.

fields.label: Factors and order reference
fields.guidance: Factors apply only to declared portions; no universal multiplier.

fields.label: Minimum effort rule
fields.guidance: State where the minimum applies in calculation order.

fields.label: Rounding rule reference
fields.guidance: Retain unrounded detail; governed precision/order.

fields.label: Activity coverage key
fields.guidance: Identify overlap across profiles, assemblies and project work.

fields.label: Covered component IDs
fields.guidance: Evidence needed for assembly coverage.

fields.label: Replaced activities
fields.guidance: Explicit precedence; otherwise unresolved conflict.

fields.label: Standard evidence source
fields.guidance: Source standard and independent expected examples.

fields.label: Standard review state
fields.guidance: Excel value does not authorise publication.

fields.label: PPO company key
fields.guidance: Company-scoped registry; no cross-company lookup.

fields.label: Publication state
fields.guidance: Separate from technical review; an Excel entry publishes nothing.

fields.label: Standards owner
fields.guidance: Nominated accountable owner; not inferred from workbook editor.

fields.label: Included subactivities
fields.guidance: Identify exactly which work the standard covers.

fields.label: Standard exclusions
fields.guidance: Identify omitted work; blank does not confirm no exclusions.

Delivery scope.purpose: One project activity selection. Keep independent applicability, selection, responsibility and review fields.

fields.label: Activity instance ID
fields.guidance: Stable resolved-ledger position.

fields.label: Estimate alternative ID
fields.guidance: One ledger per alternative; never combine competitors.

fields.label: System/line instance ID
fields.guidance: Shared work has one accountable owner.

fields.label: Exact workbench run ID
fields.guidance: Must match accepted parts/facts.

fields.label: Source content hash
fields.guidance: Exact workbench or saved Manual/project basis hash; never invent a run.

fields.label: Profile ID and version
fields.guidance: No automatic latest version.

fields.label: Activity standard reference
fields.guidance: Manual basis is separately reviewed.

fields.label: Applicability
fields.guidance: Not a commercial selection.

fields.label: Commercial selection
fields.guidance: Offered option is separately priced, not added to base.

fields.label: Delivery responsibility
fields.guidance: By others does not by itself mean excluded.

fields.label: Coverage basis
fields.guidance: Coverage evidence required; do not charge twice.

fields.label: Coverage evidence/owner
fields.guidance: Exact supplier quote/assembly or accountable activity reference.

fields.label: Effective installed quantity
fields.guidance: Use only with InstalledQuantity and its exact driver unit; leave blank for test/session drivers. Exclude spares and purchase packs.

fields.label: Effective driver unit
fields.guidance: Exact dimensional basis.

fields.label: Manual effort basis
fields.guidance: Reasoned evidence and applicable review; no silent zero.

fields.label: Technical review
fields.guidance: Separate from commercial review.

fields.label: Commercial scope review
fields.guidance: Unknown required responsibility or coverage blocks Use.

fields.label: PPO company key
fields.guidance: Exact company context.

fields.label: Estimating workspace ID
fields.guidance: Exact workspace owning the alternative.

fields.label: Saved scope revision
fields.guidance: Immutable Discovery or Express revision.

fields.label: Source workbench instance
fields.guidance: Instance identity distinct from system and run; leave blank for project Manual work.

fields.label: Effective driver key
fields.guidance: Use the selected standard driver: installed quantity, trials, sessions or project work.

fields.label: Exact fact reference
fields.guidance: Exact derived fact ID/version and source; Manual/project basis must be evidenced.

fields.label: Project profile exception
fields.guidance: Record reviewed project-specific inheritance or coverage exception.

fields.label: Saved scope type
fields.guidance: Do not fabricate Complete Discovery for Express.

fields.label: Effective quantity basis
fields.guidance: Installed quantity is one basis; packs/waste do not automatically drive effort.

fields.label: Effective driver quantity
fields.guidance: Tests, sessions or installed quantity in the exact driver unit; CPQ resolves the approved value.

Content links.purpose: One profile-to-content link. Approved clause text stays in the shared content library.

fields.label: Content link ID
fields.guidance: Stable link; not the clause identity.

fields.label: Profile ID and version
fields.guidance: Project clauses need not belong to a Product.

fields.label: Content clause ID
fields.guidance: Reference approved content, not ad hoc boilerplate.

fields.label: Clause version
fields.guidance: Exact version bound at quotation preparation.

fields.label: Content category
fields.guidance: Keep promises and qualifications distinguishable.

fields.label: Audience
fields.guidance: Default Internal until permitted review/selection.

fields.label: Content applicability
fields.guidance: Must follow resolved structured scope.

fields.label: Quotation package
fields.guidance: Group at system/package level, not repeated per SKU.

fields.label: Deduplication key
fields.guidance: One applicable block per declared coverage.

fields.label: Contradiction group
fields.guidance: Detect included service versus exclusion conflicts.

fields.label: Allowed merge fields
fields.guidance: No costs, margin or productivity by default.

fields.label: Permitted edit policy
fields.guidance: Prose edits cannot silently change delivery scope.

fields.label: Clause approval state
fields.guidance: Must match actual library approval; not conferred here.

fields.label: Approval evidence
fields.guidance: Actual content owner approval.

fields.label: Content owner
fields.guidance: Accountable clause owner from the approved library; not the workbook editor.

fields.label: Package section order
fields.guidance: Deterministic order within the package; no text-similarity deduplication.

fields.label: Exact clause content hash
fields.guidance: Bind approved wording and typed fields from the library; no latest reference.

Evidence.purpose: One source or review evidence record. Use controlled private references for operational material.

fields.label: Evidence source ID
fields.guidance: Stable reference used by field-level source cells.

fields.label: Evidence type
fields.guidance: Public catalogue data is not trial confirmation.

fields.label: Source title
fields.guidance: No copied confidential supplier data in public examples.

fields.label: Exact document/reference
fields.guidance: Private document-store identity when operational; no credentials.

fields.label: Source revision
fields.guidance: Preserve original external identity/version.

fields.label: Retained source hash
fields.guidance: Verified bytes hash only; blank is unknown.

fields.label: Retrieved/observed date
fields.guidance: Real date in YYYY-MM-DD display.

fields.label: Applicable model/options
fields.guidance: Do not generalise between generations or regional variants.

fields.label: Applicable test scenario
fields.guidance: Container/media/staffing and rate basis.

fields.label: Page/section/table
fields.guidance: Locate the exact claim or standard.

fields.label: Contradictory evidence
fields.guidance: Retain both claims; no quiet selection of favourable value.

fields.label: Conflict resolution
fields.guidance: Reviewer, reason and exact replacement evidence.

fields.label: Evidence review state
fields.guidance: Review does not imply manufacturer confirmation.

fields.label: Reviewer
fields.guidance: Actual reviewer and scope of review.

fields.label: Review date
fields.guidance: Real date; do not prefill acceptance.

fields.label: Clarification owner
fields.guidance: Named owner/role; no automatic customer message.

notes: All entry values are blank. Synthetic examples are guidance only, never active catalogue data.
This is a staging template, not an importer, operational standard, published profile or CPQ calculation engine.
Document lifecycle uses Git; schema_version describes this field dictionary only.
